verdict.rationale: Fastmail exposes a JMAP session resource for authenticated, per-account runtime discovery of capabilities, accounts and API URLs, and points to the IETF RFCs as the full API specification. Its own developer page says this is not a downloadable OpenAPI-style spec and that no OpenAPI exists on fastmail.com, and probes of common OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404. Runtime discovery plus prose RFCs is an adjacent feature, not a downloadable machine-readable spec file.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: The JMAP session resource can be found at https://api.fastmail.com/jmap/session
